card.name: Opening quote mark after a closed quote
card.fires_on: A double quotation mark that opens a new quoted passage right after a previous quotation has just ended. It is often the start of a separate quote or sentence.

modes.label: Quote opens after a quote closes
modes.description: A new opening quote mark directly follows a sentence-ending closing quote.
